exercises.name_ar: تحرير ذاتي للعضلة التوأمية والنعلية بالرول
preparation: Cross the left leg over the right leg to increase pressure (optional).
movement: Slowly roll the calf area to find the most tender spot.
Once identified, hold the tender spot until discomfort is reduced; minimum 30 seconds.
coaching_cues: Relax consciously while holding the tender spot.
safety_notes: Stop or modify if the client cannot tolerate the pressure.

exercises.name_en: Tensor Fascia Latae/Iliotibial Band Foam Roll
exercises.name_ar: تحرير ذاتي للـTFL/الشريط الحرقفي الظنبوبي بالرول
preparation: Lie on one side with the foam roll just in front of the hip.
Cross the top leg over the lower leg, with the foot touching the floor.
movement: Slowly roll from the hip joint to the lateral knee to find the most tender spot.
Once identified, hold the tender spot until discomfort is reduced; minimum 30 seconds.
coaching_cues: Move slowly while locating the tender spot.
Maintain control of the body position.
safety_notes: Stop or modify if the client cannot tolerate the pressure.
